mathematics.zero_random_effect: As covariance tends to zero the random effects and their conditional modes tend to zero. Relative error against zero is undefined; each listed R/Python covariance must have every absolute eigenvalue <=1e-9, and every mode must have absolute value <=1e-8. Only named exceptional fields use the corresponding absolute comparison.
mathematics.absent_zi: For mixing probability p, a nonzero observation changes conditional log density by log(1-p); a zero observation changes it by log((1-p)+p/f0). The test derives both changes from the normalized density and requires the weighted sum of absolute changes <=1e-6 for both implementations. It also requires max(p)<=1e-6/total_weight and observed ZI curvature norm <=1e-6. Observed logit information is Z.T diag(w*(p*(1-p)-q*(1-q)*I[y=0])) Z, where q is the posterior conditional-component probability.
mathematics.zi_wald_p: The absent-mixture limit has no finite logit MLE or covariance and no defined Wald ratio. Its derived ZI Wald p-value exception is listed explicitly. Conditional and dispersion Wald p values remain strict.
